headword: {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}

definitions.gloss: reader submission; contribution sent in by a reader
definitions.explanation: A letter, comment, photo, or short piece submitted by a member of the public for publication in a newspaper, magazine, or website. Most often seen as part of the compound {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}{欄|らん} (reader submissions column).

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a reader contribution to the magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{載|の}った。
examples.english: My opinion was printed in the newspaper's reader submissions column.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{毎号|まいごう}⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧している。
examples.english: This magazine features reader-submitted photos in every issue.

notes:
⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧ (reader) + ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧ (submission/posting): material sent in by ordinary readers rather than staff writers, for print or online publication.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: reader submissions column
- {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send in a reader contribution
- {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: reader-submitted photo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投書|とうしょ}→投書：04556_tousho⟧: a letter to the editor — narrower, usually a written opinion piece, while {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう} also covers photos and other content
- ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: the general word for a section/column that {読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ attaches to
